name: Tal
source:
Sister of [url=/c97700]Lua[/url], she is always energetic and childish. Although her brother is highly capacitated in magic, she barely can cast any minor spell. Often she has to clean his brother messes and cook for him, even if she is not good at it.
Her dream is to become a ninja or assassin.
